title: Stochastic Games on Large Sparse Graphs
summary: We introduce a framework for stochastic games on large sparse graphs, covering continuous-time and discrete-time dynamic games as well as static games. Players are indexed by the vertices of simple, locally finite graphs, allowing both finite and countably infinite populations, with asymptotics described through local weak convergence of marked graphs. The framework allows path-dependent utility functionals that may be heterogeneous across players.
